actions.name: Post Approval Card to Microsoft Teams
actions.description: Post an Adaptive Card asking for a decision on a Jira work item, with links into Jira and the customer portal.

conditions.description: Only run for Jira work item created events
Only run for the configured Jira project
Only request approval for the configured Jira issue type

description: Post an Adaptive Card approval request to Teams when a Jira work item needs approval

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key that should request approvals in Teams.

flowVariables.name: APPROVAL_ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira issue type that requires approval.

flowVariables.name: TEAMS_WORKFLOW_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Teams Workflows (Power Automate) HTTP request URL for the target channel. Treat it as a credential.

flowVariables.name: JSM_PORTAL_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Jira Service Management customer portal URL where approvers act on the request.

name: Microsoft Teams - Request Approval for Work Item
